headline: Hamas Security Chief Eliminated; Iran Missiles; Ukraine Massive UAV Wave
subheadline: Israeli strike in Gaza City killed Hamas internal security chief Naim Abu Nahal, while Iran fired missiles from four provinces and Lebanon recorded 143 alerts.
lede: An Israeli airstrike in Gaza City eliminated Hamas internal security chief Naim Abu Nahal, striking a key figure in the group's leadership. Iran launched missiles from Nurabad Mamasani, Aligoodarz, Kenesht Canyon and Saqqez, demonstrating dispersed launch capabilities across four provinces. Lebanon reported 143 daily alerts, including 75 drones and 40 artillery strikes focused on Bint Jbeil, Tyre, Marjayoun and Nabatieh, reflecting heightened low‑intensity conflict.

sections.title: Massive UAV Campaign Hits Ukrainian Infrastructure
sections.body: Russian forces launched a massive wave of reactive UAVs from Bryansk, Orel, Millerovo and Gvardeyskoye, striking Zaporizhzhia, Dnipro, Kyiv, Zhytomyr, Odesa and Kharkiv regions. The Zaporizhzhia attack killed two civilians, injured 32 people including four children, and destroyed a private house while damaging a five-story building. A separate Dnipro strike caused explosions, widespread power outages and damage that may have hit a railway station. Ukraine also destroyed a Russian corvette near the Libyan coast and signed a joint drone production pact with Germany to build thousands of reconnaissance drones by 2027.

sections.title: Hamas Leader Killed; Iran Missiles; Lebanon Alerts Surge
sections.body: Israeli forces struck Gaza City, killing Hamas internal security chief Naim Abu Nahal and decapitating the group's internal security apparatus. Iran fired missiles from Nurabad Mamasani, Aligoodarz, Kenesht Canyon and Saqqez, demonstrating dispersed launch capabilities across four provinces. Lebanon recorded 143 daily alerts, comprising 75 drones and 40 artillery strikes concentrated on Bint Jbeil, Tyre, Marjayoun and Nabatieh, reflecting a 54% weekly increase in low‑intensity conflict. The US Embassy in Jerusalem warned Americans of Houthi attacks and possible Iranian targeting of officials, while the UK imposed sanctions on the Houthis and four individuals for human rights abuses.

sections.title: Escalating UAV Threats and Air Defense Gaps
sections.body: Russia's coordinated UAV campaign across northern, central and southern Ukraine, coupled with its Geran‑5 incursion into Poland, signals a sustained effort to probe NATO airspace and strain Ukrainian air defenses. Simultaneously, Iran's multi‑province missile launches and Lebanon's 143 daily alerts reveal expanding low‑intensity pressure on Israel and its allies, while the withholding of Patriot interceptors critically weakens Ukraine's capacity to counter accelerating Russian missile production.
